title: Rama tells Bharata about Dasaratha's promise of kingdom
introduction: Rama reveals to Bharata that Kaikey's marriage, stating that Dasaratha would confer the kingdom as a marriage-dowry. Rama also adds that Kaikeyi also received the promise of two boons from Dasaratha as a token of his pleasure and gratitude for the help Kaikeyi rendered during the conflict long ago between gods and demons. Rama further informs Bharata that according to that promise, Kaikeyi asked for the two boons, one for Bharata's throne and another for his own exile to the forest. Rama requests Bharata to make Dasaratha's promises true and asks him to return to Ayodhya and assume its rulership.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus completes 107th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
पुनर् एवम् ब्रुवाणम् तु भरतम् लक्ष्मण अग्रजः |
प्रत्युवच ततः श्रीमान् ज्नाति मध्ये अतिसत्कृतः
verses.iast:
punar evam bruvāṇam tu bharatam lakṣmaṇa agrajaḥ |
pratyuvaca tataḥ śrīmān jnāti madhye atisatkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the illustrious Rama, highly respected among his fraternity, (as follows) to Bharata who was speaking as aforesaid among his relatives.

verses.devanagari:
उपपन्नम् इदम् वाक्यम् यत् त्वम् एवम् अभाषथाः |
जातः पुत्रो दशरथात् कैकेय्याम् राज सत्तमात्
verses.iast:
upapannam idam vākyam yat tvam evam abhāṣathāḥ |
jātaḥ putro daśarathāt kaikeyyām rāja sattamāt
verses.translation: "These words, which you have spoken are worthy of you, the son of Dasaratha the excellent king, born through Kaikeyi."

verses.devanagari:
पुरा भ्रातः पिता नः स मातरम् ते समुद्वहन् |
मातामहे समाश्रौषीद् राज्य शुल्कम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
purā bhrātaḥ pitā naḥ sa mātaram te samudvahan |
mātāmahe samāśrauṣīd rājya śulkam anuttamam
verses.translation: "O, My brother! Long ago, when our father married your mother, he promised your maternal grandfather that he would confer his kingdom as an exceptional marriage-dowry"

glosses.meaning: marriage dowry in the form of our kingdom

verses.devanagari:
देव असुरे च सम्ग्रामे जनन्यै तव पार्थिवः |
सम्प्रहृष्टो ददौ राजा वरम् आराधितः प्रभुः
verses.iast:
deva asure ca samgrāme jananyai tava pārthivaḥ |
samprahṛṣṭo dadau rājā varam ārādhitaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, in a conflict between Gods and demons, your mother received the promise of two boons from the efficient lord of the earth, King Dasartha, as a token of his joy and gratitude."

verses.devanagari:
ततः सा सम्प्रतिश्राव्य तव माता यशस्विनी |
अयाचत नर श्रेष्ठम् द्वौ वरौ वर वर्णिनी
तव राज्यम् नर व्याघ्र मम प्रव्राजनम् तथा |
तच् च राजा तथा तस्यै नियुक्तः प्रददौ वरौ
verses.iast:
tataḥ sā sampratiśrāvya tava mātā yaśasvinī |
ayācata nara śreṣṭham dvau varau vara varṇinī
tava rājyam nara vyāghra mama pravrājanam tathā |
tac ca rājā tathā tasyai niyuktaḥ pradadau varau
verses.translation: "O, Tiger among men! Your illustrious mother of beautiful complexion consequently demanded these two boons from that cheif of men, for you the throne and for me the exile to the forest."

glosses.meaning: by Dasaratha the chief of men

verses.devanagari:
तेन पित्रा अहम् अप्य् अत्र नियुक्तः पुरुष ऋषभ |
चतुर्दश वने वासम् वर्षाणि वरदानिकम्
verses.iast:
tena pitrā aham apy atra niyuktaḥ puruṣa ṛṣabha |
caturdaśa vane vāsam varṣāṇi varadānikam
verses.translation: "O, excellent among men! I too, have been enjoined by our aforesaid father to live here in the forest for fourteen years, in accord iwth granting of boon."

glosses.meaning: in accord with the granting of boon.

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् वनम् इदम् प्राप्तो निर्जनम् लक्ष्मण अन्वितः |
शीतया च अप्रतिद्वन्द्वः सत्य वादे स्थितः पितुः
verses.iast:
so aham vanam idam prāpto nirjanam lakṣmaṇa anvitaḥ |
śītayā ca apratidvandvaḥ satya vāde sthitaḥ pituḥ
verses.translation: "I as such, without any rival, have come to this lonely forest accompanied by Lakshmana and Seetha in order to carry out the promise given by our father."

verses.devanagari:
भवान् अपि तथा इत्य् एव पितरम् सत्य वादिनम् |
कर्तुम् अर्हति राज इन्द्रम् क्षिप्रम् एव अभिषेचनात्
verses.iast:
bhavān api tathā ity eva pitaram satya vādinam |
kartum arhati rāja indram kṣipram eva abhiṣecanāt
verses.translation: "You too ought, likewise, to make our father, as a person having given a true promise, O Indra (the Lord of Celestials) among kings, by getting yourself anointed to the crown without any delay.

glosses.meaning: as a person having given a true promise
by getting anointed to the crown

verses.devanagari:
ऋणान् मोचय राजानम् मत् कृते भरत प्रभुम् |
पितरम् त्राहि धर्मज्न मातरम् च अभिनन्दय
verses.iast:
ṛṇān mocaya rājānam mat kṛte bharata prabhum |
pitaram trāhi dharmajna mātaram ca abhinandaya
verses.translation: "O, Bharata! For my sake relieve the mighty king from his vow and make both our mother and fahter happy."

glosses.meaning: make our father and happy mother.

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयते हि पुरा तात श्रुतिर् गीता यशस्विनी |
गयेन यजमानेन गयेषु एव पितृऋन् प्रति
verses.iast:
śrūyate hi purā tāta śrutir gītā yaśasvinī |
gayena yajamānena gayeṣu eva pitṛṛn prati
verses.translation: "My dear brother! Formerly, an illustrious king named Gaya, while perfoming a sacrifice in a place called Gaya in honour of his ancestors, chanted the following verse:

verses.devanagari:
पुम् नाम्ना नरकाद् यस्मात् पितरम् त्रायते सुतः |
तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः पितृऋन् यत् पाति वा सुतः
verses.iast:
pum nāmnā narakād yasmāt pitaram trāyate sutaḥ |
tasmāt putra iti proktaḥ pitṛṛn yat pāti vā sutaḥ
verses.translation: "Since a son delivers his father from a place of torment (hell) called 'Put', he is named as 'Putra'- 'he who delivers his ancestors from all dangers'"

verses.devanagari:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा गुणवन्तो बहु श्रुताः |
तेषाम् वै समवेतानाम् अपि कश्चिद् गयाम् व्रजेत्
verses.iast:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā guṇavanto bahu śrutāḥ |
teṣām vai samavetānām api kaścid gayām vrajet
verses.translation: "To have many virtuous and learned sons is to be desired, since one, atleast among them, who is intimately connected will ocme to Gaya to perform a sacrifice."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् राज ऋषयः सर्वे प्रतीता राज नन्दन |
तस्मात् त्राहि नर श्रेष्ठ पितरम् नरकात् प्रभो
verses.iast:
evam rāja ṛṣayaḥ sarve pratītā rāja nandana |
tasmāt trāhi nara śreṣṭha pitaram narakāt prabho
verses.translation: "O, prince! This is the conviction of all the royal sages. O, the efficient and the excellent of men! Therefore, save our father from hell.

glosses.meaning: in this narashreSTa = and the excellent among men!

verses.devanagari:
अयोध्याम् गग्च्छ भरत प्रकृतीर् अनुरन्जय |
शत्रुघ्न सहितो वीर सह सर्वैर् द्विजातिभिः
verses.iast:
ayodhyām gagccha bharata prakṛtīr anuranjaya |
śatrughna sahito vīra saha sarvair dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: "O, the valiant Bharata! Go to Ayodhya along with Shatrughna and all the Brahmanas and give joy to the people there."

verses.devanagari:
प्रवेक्ष्ये दण्डक अरण्यम् अहम् अप्य् अविलम्बयन् |
आभ्याम् तु सहितो राजन् वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च
verses.iast:
pravekṣye daṇḍaka araṇyam aham apy avilambayan |
ābhyām tu sahito rājan vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca
verses.translation: "O, King! I too, without delay, will proceed to Dandaka forest along with Seetha and Lakshaman."

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् राजा भव भरत स्वयम् नराणाम् |
वन्यानाम् अहम् अपि राज राण् मृगाणाम् |
गग्च्छ त्वम् पुर वरम् अद्य सम्प्रहृष्टः |
सम्हृष्टः तु अहम् अपि दण्डकान् प्रवेक्ष्ये
verses.iast:
tvam rājā bhava bharata svayam narāṇām |
vanyānām aham api rāja rāṇ mṛgāṇām |
gagccha tvam pura varam adya samprahṛṣṭaḥ |
samhṛṣṭaḥ tu aham api daṇḍakān pravekṣye
verses.translation: "O, Bharata! You become the Lord of men. I will become the emperor of the wild beasts of the forest! Return now to the excellent city of Ayodhya full of joy and I also full of joy will enter Dankada Forest!"

glosses.meaning: to the excellent city of Ayodhya

verses.devanagari:
चायाम् ते दिन कर भाः प्रबाधमानम् |
वर्षत्रम् भरत करोतु मूर्ध्नि शीताम् |
एतेषाम् अहम् अपि कानन द्रुमाणाम् |
चायाम् ताम् अतिशयिनीम् सुखम् श्रयिष्ये
verses.iast:
cāyām te dina kara bhāḥ prabādhamānam |
varṣatram bharata karotu mūrdhni śītām |
eteṣām aham api kānana drumāṇām |
cāyām tām atiśayinīm sukham śrayiṣye
verses.translation: "O, Bharata! Let the (royal) white umbrella provide a cool shadow for your head, repulsing the rays of sunlight. I will take shelter comoftably under the abundant shadow of these forest-trees."

verses.devanagari:
शत्रुघ्नः कुशल मतिः तु ते सहायः |
सौमित्रिर् मम विदितः प्रधान मित्रम् |
चत्वारः तनय वरा वयम् नर इन्द्रम् |
सत्यस्थम् भरत चराम मा विषादम्
verses.iast:
śatrughnaḥ kuśala matiḥ tu te sahāyaḥ |
saumitrir mama viditaḥ pradhāna mitram |
catvāraḥ tanaya varā vayam nara indram |
satyastham bharata carāma mā viṣādam
verses.translation: "O, Bharata! The wise Shatrughna is helpful to you. Lakshmana is known to be an outstanding friend for me. We, the four excellent sons, will ultimately make the king true to his promise. Do not get disappointed."
